Every service below is quoted and carried out by an independent, owner-run local pressure washing company. Houston Power Washing Pro answers the phone and puts you through. Use this page to work out which service fits what you are looking at, so the call is quick.

The biggest difference between services is the method. Hard surfaces like concrete get pressure washing: high-pressure water, usually through a rotary surface cleaner. Siding, roofs and most wood get soft washing: low pressure with a cleaning solution that kills mildew and algae so a gentle rinse carries it away. A careful company switches between the two on the same property.

The home exterior

Siding, roofs and gutters are where high pressure does the most damage, so these are soft wash jobs.

House Washing and Soft Washing

Low-pressure soft washing for brick, fiber cement, vinyl and stucco, so green mildew and black streaks come off without forcing water behind the siding.

Common questions

Can I get several things cleaned in one visit?

Usually, yes. Many Houston calls are for a house wash plus the driveway, or a roof plus gutters. Tell the assistant everything you want done so the company hears the full picture before it calls you back or picks up.

What is the difference between pressure washing and soft washing?

Pressure washing uses high-pressure water and suits hard surfaces like concrete. Soft washing uses low pressure plus a cleaning solution and suits siding, stucco, roofs and painted or soft wood. Shingle and siding makers warn against high pressure on their products.

Is there anything the line cannot help with?

Yes. Painting, sealing or staining as a main job, window cleaning, gutter repair or installation, water-damage restoration, indoor mold remediation and equipment sales or rentals are not offered. If you are unsure, call and ask.

Do you handle businesses as well as homes?

The line connects businesses too. See commercial pressure washing for storefronts, sidewalks, dumpster pads and drive-thrus.

Not sure which service you need?

Call and describe what you see, such as green on the siding, black streaks on the roof or a dark driveway. The company you are connected with can tell you what the surface needs and give you its own price.
